tollsAndPermits: The NH44/NH48 run (Delhi–Agra–Gwalior–Jhansi–Nagpur–Hyderabad–Bengaluru) spans six states. National permit, state check-post entries and the longest toll chain on our network are itemised openly in the quote; the GST e-way bill for the interstate consignment is generated by our team before dispatch.

faqs.q: How many days does Delhi to Bengaluru take?
faqs.a: Dedicated trucks deliver in 4–6 days door to door on the roughly 2,180 km NH44 run via Nagpur and Hyderabad. Shared loads add time for route consolidation — we state the realistic window for your chosen mode in writing, including the Bengaluru society delivery slot.

faqs.q: What does a 2 BHK Delhi to Bengaluru move cost?
faqs.a: It depends on your inventory, floors, lift access, packing level and distance. We run a free survey (video or doorstep) and then confirm an itemised written quote — no advance is needed to book.

faqs.q: Is my household stuff safe over such a long route?
faqs.a: Long-haul risk is managed by packing grade and consignment discipline: sealed loading, a shared inventory list, night-halt discipline on the corridor, and transit insurance on declared value. Fragiles and electronics get export-grade packing on this route as standard practice.

faqs.q: Can I send just a few boxes, not a full house?
faqs.a: Yes — part-load consignments on this corridor are routine. Charges follow volume/weight slabs rather than full-truck pricing; the trade-off is a wider delivery window, which we state up front.

faqs.q: Does the truck halt overnight? Where?
faqs.a: Long-haul drivers follow regulated driving hours with planned night halts along the corridor — typically around the Nagpur–Hyderabad stretch. Consignments stay sealed and parked at known, lit stops; the delivery schedule already accounts for these halts.

notes: At ~2,180 km this is the longest seeded corridor and the one where packing grade matters most: three to four days of road means vibration, so electronics, glass and crockery move in double-walled cartons with foam, and furniture edges get corner protection. Trucks run NH44 via Agra, Gwalior, Nagpur and Hyderabad, with planned night halts — delivery windows are quoted inclusive of them. Bengaluru delivery slots must respect apartment move-hour windows, so arrival is timed for morning.
